title: Fast summation on rectangular cuboids with arbitrary periodicity in the DMK framework
summary: Dual-space multilevel kernel-splitting (DMK) is a fast summation framework that combines ideas from the fast multipole method, Ewald summation, and multilevel summation. Originally formulated for free-space problems, and later extended to fully periodic problems on a cube, it decomposes the kernel interaction into a smooth global contribution and a hierarchy of localized interactions evaluated on an octree.
